correctness.rationale: For all integers m,k with 2<=k<=m/2, group averaging reduces global symmetric stochastic SLEM optimization on two disjoint K_m joined by a size-k matching to orbit parameters. The odd-between-cliques 2x2 symmetric block lower bounds SLEM; its upper eigenvalue decreases in matching weight, forcing boundary y=1-(m-k)x. The remaining f(x)=((m-2k)x+sqrt(4-4mx+(m²+4mk-4k²)x²))/2 is strictly convex, with unique minimizer x=sqrt2/[(1+sqrt2)m-2k]. Independently symbolically confirmed at x that radicand equals 2 and f(x) equals (m-4k+2sqrt2 k)/(m+2k-2sqrt2 k). Proposed complete kernel saturates gateway rows, sets gateway-gateway intra-clique edges to zero, and its explicit even/odd and local eigenblocks keep all remaining nonconstant eigenvalues inside +/-rho. Independent full symmetric eigenspectra for (m,k)=(4,2),(6,2),(6,3),(10,4),(20,10) agree with formula at numerical precision. No global uniqueness for arbitrary edge weights asserted.
